import andes
import numpy as np

    setup=False,
    no_output=True,
    log=False,
)

    param_dict={

        "idx": "PQ_VERIFY_003_A",

)

result_json["min_bus"] = int(bus_ids[int(np.argmin(bus_v))])
result_json["min_voltage"] = round(float(bus_v[int(np.argmin(bus_v))]), 6)
